what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in 1962, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1962 report prints no such schedule: the school lunch and athletic accounts appear as accounts in the accountant's schedule (p35) and in the School Department's own reports (p111, p122), and the balance sheet carries unexpended balances (p16). Searched special revenue and revolving: no hit (sources/data/report-tables/1962/). — closes: the Town Accountant's calendar-1962 special revenue fund ledger.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in 1962?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1962 report prints special articles with their balances in the accountant's schedule (p26-37) and the voted special articles (p66-67), and no capital plan or project fund schedule; searched capital project, capital plan and capital improvement: the only hits are school prose (p93, p96, p109) (sources/data/report-tables/1962/). — closes: the Town Accountant's calendar-1962 capital projects ledger.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1962, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds device counts from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1962 report gives one sentence (p45: `One hundred sixty weighing and measuring devices were adjusted and sealed during 1962`, net cost to the Town $428.09) and the Treasurer's receipt line `Sealer's Fees` $93.10 (p20), with no count or fee by device type; searched weights and measures, sealer, devices (sources/data/report-tables/1962/). — closes: the Sealer of Weights and Measures' 1962 test and fee record.
